Definition: Is the register integrated with the national ID system?
Comments: PRODIGY project integrates civil registration with biometric national ID, pilot under development.
redteam_note: Only one source for a substantive score — corroborate.
revision_notes: Upgraded from 3 to 4. By June 2026 Madagascar had enrolled 2.6 million people in its biometric digital ID in two months, explicitly built on a 'retroactive' civil-registration model linking identity to civil-registration documents (Biometric Update, 5 June 2026); the World Bank's PRODIGY implementation report confirms birth registrations are issued with a linked Unique Identification Number (UIN) and that this is being scaled nationally. This is beyond a small pilot and supports 'Partially integrated' rather than merely 'Under development', though nationwide/bidirectional integration is not yet confirmed.

Definition: Does the register cover births, deaths and marriages?
Comments: Covers births, deaths, marriages as standard civil registration per FamilySearch and reports.
redteam_note: Only one source for a substantive score — corroborate.
revision_notes: Downgraded from 3 (All) to 2 (Some). The cited FamilySearch page describes historical, largely paper archival civil-registration records (1897-present) and does not evidence digital capture of any event type, so it does not support the original score. The World Bank's PRODIGY results framework shows a 'Digitalised civil registration records' indicator at zero actual progress against a 2M target, with only a birth-registration/UIN pilot (~3,000 newborns) evidenced; no equivalent digital capture of deaths or marriages was found. Only births show confirmed digital-capture progress, hence 'Some'.

Definition: Does the government maintain a digital land register?
Comments: Land registry exists (Livre foncier, Conservation foncière), registration process described in Doing Business, but low coverage (5-10% titled). Digital aspects not confirmed but formal system partially deployed.
redteam_note: Only one source for a substantive score — corroborate.
revision_notes: Confirmed, sources replaced. The original Doing Business archive PDF is a generic, outdated (2020) methodology document that does not actually contain Madagascar-specific digital land data. Better evidence: the National Land Programme II report (Oct 2024) records 699,816 land titles and 1.5 million land certificates registered, but states no single integrated land information software yet exists nationally, only isolated digitisation pilots; a digital-delimitation programme (2025) and an automated certificate-issuing kiosk in Antananarivo (July 2025) confirm partial, non-uniform digitisation. This supports 'Partially deployed' rather than a higher or lower code.

revision_notes: Confirmed, figures updated. The original cited URL could not be fetched (timeout) but is corroborated and superseded by fresher reporting: the Registre Social Unique reached 1.82 million households by 31 December 2025 and 2.6 million households by May 2026 (allAfrica; 2424.mg), already exceeding the ministry's June 2026 target, with mass enrolment continuing in 99 districts to end-2026 and full national coverage targeted for 2030. 'Partially deployed' remains the correct code.

Definition: Does the government maintain one or more tax registers?
Comments: Digital tax administration with e-HETRA, e-invoicing mandatory rollout, TIN (NIF) system.
redteam_note: Only one source for a substantive score — corroborate.
revision_notes: Confirmed. The DGI's HETRAONLINE/e-Hetra portal provides nationwide online tax registration (NIF), tele-declaration and e-payment for IR, IRSA, IS and VAT, and is mandatory for large taxpayers (Direction des Grandes Entreprises). A November 2025 allAfrica report shows some operational friction with the mandatory online-only rules but confirms the system is deployed and in nationwide use rather than merely developing. 'Fully deployed nationwide' stands.
